desc: Ideation: derive that for a fixed center c, each neighbor m can serve as a middle vertex with capacity deg(m)-1 leaves, and the best snowflake centered at c is obtained by choosing x largest positive capacities and setting y to the x-th largest capacity.
Implement direct center-enumeration solution in Python with adjacency lists, degree array, per-center positive capacity sorting, prefix scan, best initialized to 3, and output N-best.
Verify edge cases: N=3 path, star trees, centers with degree 1, centers with no positive-capacity neighbors, y>=1, x>=1.
Confirm complexity is O(N log N) total and memory is O(N), avoiding recursion and excessive temporary allocations.
Run public sample tests; all passed.
